assumptions: The alignment given is the read against its intended reference.
limits: The verdict's identity and coverage thresholds are SpliceCraft's defaults unless changed; it grades the alignment, not the trace.
bio.jane/contract.question: Does a sequencing read verify the reference, and which differences does it show?

description: Grade a sequencing read against a reference (✓ verified / ⚠ near / ~ partial / ✗ divergent) from an alignment.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

near_coverage_pct.description: reference coverage required to grade a read near. In %.

near_ungapped_pct.description: ungapped identity required to grade a read near — NOT the gap-inclusive `identity` output. In %.

read_name.description: what to call the read in the report row.

target_len.description: reference length in bp. In bp.

target_name.description: what to call the reference in the report row.

verified_coverage_pct.description: reference coverage required to grade a read verified. In %.

verified_max_gaps.description: gaps tolerated in a verified alignment.

verified_ungapped_pct.description: ungapped identity required to grade a read verified — NOT the gap-inclusive `identity` output. In %.

name: verify_read

coveragePct.description: how much of the reference the read actually covers — a perfect identity over 20% of the target is not a verified clone

indelEvents.description: insertion/deletion EVENTS, not bases — one 12 bp deletion is one event

report.description: the row that goes in the record: target, read, grade, ungapped identity, coverage, mismatches and indel events

result.description: the full alignment result (matches, mismatches, gaps, identities)

status.description: the grade: verified / near / partial / divergent
